sentences.en: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
sentences.zh: 你的时间是有限的，所以不要浪费时间去过别人的生活。

sentences.en: Don't be trapped by dogma, which is living with the results of other people's thinking.
sentences.zh: 不要被教条所束缚，那是活在别人思考的结果中。

sentences.en: Don't let the noise of others' opinions drown out your own inner voice.
sentences.zh: 不要让别人意见的噪音淹没了你内心的声音。

sentences.en: And most important, have the courage to follow your heart and intuition.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，要有勇气跟随你的内心和直觉。

sentences.en: They somehow already know what you truly want to become.
sentences.zh: 它们 somehow 已经知道你真正想成为什么样的人。

sentences.en: Everything else is secondary.
sentences.zh: 其他一切都是次要的。

sentences.en: Connection is why we're here.
sentences.zh: 连接是我们存在的意义。

sentences.en: It's what gives purpose and meaning to our lives.
sentences.zh: 它赋予了我们生活的目的和意义。

sentences.en: Vulnerability is not weakness.
sentences.zh: 脆弱不是软弱。

sentences.en: It's our greatest measure of courage.
sentences.zh: 它是我们衡量勇气的最大标准。

sentences.en: To love with our whole hearts, even though there's no guarantee, is the only way to live.
sentences.zh: 全心全意地去爱，即使没有保证，这是唯一的生活方式。

sentences.en: We are hardwired for connection, and without it, we suffer.
sentences.zh: 我们天生就需要连接，没有它，我们就会痛苦。

sentences.en: Grit is passion and perseverance for very long-term goals.
sentences.zh: 坚毅是对长期目标的激情和坚持。

sentences.en: It's living life like it's a marathon, not a sprint.
sentences.zh: 它是把生活当作马拉松，而不是短跑。

sentences.en: Talent is important, but effort counts twice.
sentences.zh: 天赋很重要，但努力的作用是双倍的。

sentences.en: When you combine talent with effort, you get skill.
sentences.zh: 当你把天赋和努力结合起来，你就获得了技能。

sentences.en: And when you apply that skill with more effort, you achieve.
sentences.zh: 当你把更多的努力应用到那种技能上，你就取得了成就。

sentences.en: Grit can grow over time, and that is good news.
sentences.zh: 坚毅可以随着时间增长，这是个好消息。

sentences.en: People don't buy what you do, they buy why you do it.
sentences.zh: 人们不买你做什么，他们买你为什么做。

sentences.en: The goal is not to do business with everybody who needs what you have.
sentences.zh: 目标不是和所有需要你产品的人做生意。

sentences.en: The goal is to do business with people who believe what you believe.
sentences.zh: 目标是和那些相信你所相信的人做生意。

sentences.en: Inspired leaders think, act, and communicate from the inside out.
sentences.zh: 有感染力的领导者从内而外地思考、行动和沟通。

sentences.en: If you talk about what you believe, you will attract those who believe what you believe.
sentences.zh: 如果你谈论你所相信的，你会吸引那些和你有相同信念的人。

sentences.en: Trust is not a checklist of policies and procedures.
sentences.zh: 信任不是政策和程序的清单。

title: Your body language shapes who you are
speaker: Amy Cuddy

sentences.en: Our bodies change our minds, and our minds change our behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们的身体改变我们的心态，而我们的心态改变我们的行为。

sentences.en: And our behavior changes our outcomes.
sentences.zh: 而我们的行为改变我们的结果。

sentences.en: Don't fake it till you make it, fake it till you become it.
sentences.zh: 不要假装直到成功，要假装直到你真正成为那样。

sentences.en: Small tweaks can lead to big changes in your life.
sentences.zh: 微小的调整可以给你的生活带来巨大的改变。

sentences.en: Before you go into a stressful situation, take two minutes to power pose.
sentences.zh: 在你进入压力情境之前，花两分钟做一个有力量的姿势。

sentences.en: The most powerful thing you can do is to be present.
sentences.zh: 你能做的最有力的事情就是活在当下。

title: The surprising habits of original thinkers
speaker: Adam Grant

sentences.en: Originals are people who take the initiative to make their visions a reality.
sentences.zh: 创想家是那些主动将愿景变成现实的人。

sentences.en: They are quick to start but slow to finish.
sentences.zh: 他们开始得很快，但完成得很慢。

sentences.en: Procrastination can be a vice for productivity, but a virtue for creativity.
sentences.zh: 拖延对生产力来说是恶习，但对创造力来说是美德。

sentences.en: The greatest originals are the ones who fail the most, because they try the most.
sentences.zh: 最伟大的创想家是失败最多的人，因为他们尝试得最多。

sentences.en: You need a lot of bad ideas in order to get a few good ones.
sentences.zh: 你需要很多糟糕的想法，才能得到几个好的。

sentences.en: Being original is about taking action, not just having ideas.
sentences.zh: 成为创想家是关于采取行动，而不仅仅是有想法。

sentences.en: I've learned that people will forget what you said.
sentences.zh: 我学到人们会忘记你说过什么。

sentences.en: People will forget what you did.
sentences.zh: 人们会忘记你做过什么。

sentences.en: But people will never forget how you made them feel.
sentences.zh: 但人们永远不会忘记你让他们感受到什么。

sentences.en: Life is short, and it is up to us to make it sweet.
sentences.zh: 生命短暂，让它变得甜蜜取决于我们。

sentences.en: When you learn, teach, when you get, give.
sentences.zh: 当你学习时，去教导；当你获得时，去给予。

sentences.en: We may encounter many defeats, but we must not be defeated.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会遇到很多挫折，但我们绝不能被打败。
